test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: All 30 students of a class are standing in a straight row facing the north. Komal is 8th from the right end while Priya is 14th from the left end. How many students are standing between Komal and Priya?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Total number of students in the class = 30

Position of Komal from the right end = 8th

Thus, position of Komal from the left end = (Total number of students + 1) - Position of Komal from the right end

= 30 + 1 - 8

= 31 - 8

= 23rd

Position of Priya from the left end = 14th

Number of students standing between Komal and Priya = Position of Komal from the left end - Position of Priya from the left end - 1

= 23 - 14 - 1

= 9 - 1

= 8

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
